metadata.title: Complete Shader Workflow Test (Phase 2)
metadata.description: End-to-end graphics pipeline: geometry → camera → lighting → shader authoring → program linking → preview
metadata.phase: Phase 2: GPU integration with shader compilation and lighting

sphere.indices: List of u32 triangle indices (~3072 indices for 1024 triangles)

camera.view_direction: vec3 normalized direction from camera to target

sun_light.light_data: JSON with type='directional', normalized direction, clamped color, intensity

point_light.light_data: JSON with type='point', position, clamped color, intensity, radius

program_linker.status: Linked successfully or compilation errors in footer view

workflow_description:
Complete Phase 2 shader authoring pipeline:

1. **Geometry Generation**: Create sphere mesh with positions, normals, UVs, and indices
2. **Camera Setup**: Configure perspective camera with look-at transform
3. **Lighting**: Create directional light (sun) and point light with colors and intensities
4. **Shader Authoring**: Write GLSL vertex and fragment shaders with Phong lighting
5. **Shader Linking**: Compile and link shaders into executable GPU program
6. **Render Configuration**: Set render target parameters (resolution, format, MSAA)
7. **Preview**: Display real-time rendered output with shader preview node

This demonstrates the full graphics pipeline from data generation through shader compilation to rendering.

test_assertions.assertion: Camera outputs 4 values (view, projection, position, direction)
Directional light JSON contains required fields
Point light JSON contains required fields including radius

test_assertions.expected: Status = Success, program ID is UUID, no compilation errors

test_assertions.assertion: Preview displays rendered output or shows error message
test_assertions.expected: No runtime errors, either GPU texture or fallback placeholder

JSON strings contain properly formatted light data
